acquisition method: We used the multinotch MS3-based TMT method.
alkylation reagent: followed by alkylation with 10 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma Aldrich)
alkylation concentration: followed by alkylation with 10 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma Aldrich)
cleavage agent: Proteins were digested for 16 hours with LysC (1:100 enzyme:protein ratio) at 23°C, followed by trypsin (1:100 enzyme:protein ratio) for 6 hours at 37°C.
collision energy: MS2 analysis followed collision-induced dissociation (CID, CE = 35)... MS3 precursors were fragmented by high-energy collision-induced dissociation (HCD, CE = 65)
enrichment method: Nuclear extracts from control HEK293 cells or a Flag-CFIm25 cell line were used for immunoprecipitation with anti-Flag antibodies
fractionation method: The pooled TMT-labeled peptide sample was fractionated using BPRP HPLC.
fragmentation method: MS2 analysis followed collision-induced dissociation (CID, CE = 35)... MS3 precursors were fragmented by high-energy collision-induced dissociation (HCD, CE = 65)
instrument: Mass spectrometry data were collected using an Orbitrap Fusion mass spectrometer
labeling: TMT reagents (0.8 mg; Thermo Fisher Scientific) were dissolved
reduction reagent: Proteins were then subjected to disulfide reduction with 5mM tris (2 carboxyethyl) phosphine (TCEP; Sigma Aldrich)
reduction concentration: Proteins were then subjected to disulfide reduction with 5mM tris (2 carboxyethyl) phosphine (TCEP; Sigma Aldrich)
